summary: KE Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K providing Next Day Disclosure Returns under Hong Kong Listing Rules, disclosing open-market share repurchases during April 2026. The company repurchased a total of approximately 20.1 million shares at prices ranging from USD 4.9183 to USD 5.4958 per share, all to be held as treasury shares. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The repurchases were executed as on-market buybacks without a formal tender offer. This represents a capital return to shareholders via buybacks. Watch for future repurchase activity and potential cancellation of shares to reduce float.
